nmpsvhed.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
nmpsvhed.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
nmpsvhed.sourceDescription: This black artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. The steel feet add to its stability. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: Black Shiny rose gold, matt rose gold and glitter rose gold Material: PVC, steel, plastic Total height: 150 cm Tree diameter: 75 cm LED string light length: 15 m Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W With 380 tips With 150 LEDs With USB connection Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball Maximum 110 kg per seat. Be aware of the risk of open fires and other sources of strong heat in the vicinity of the product. GPSR • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

Cute and colourful in design, LED lights and fan are placed inside so it moves around illuminates your outdoors at night for a fun effect. Inflating in seconds to save you time, it is finished with a zip fastening so it deflates just as fast. Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely.
